method: Three sequential fresh processes per mode/input at144DPI with5warm repeats and every page. Alternating mode order; no concurrent local builds or validation. Inputs are native-generated DOCX/PPTX PDF exports. Hashing precedes timing and warms filesystem cache. Counters describe retained PdfCraft PageRenderer, not every eager extraction traversal.

runs.limitations: Synthetic or caller-selected input only. Input hashing precedes measurement and warms the filesystem cache. RSS includes native/global caches and allocator retention; peak RSS cannot decrease or prove close reclamation. Calls hold the Python GIL. No cross-format fidelity or throughput guarantee.
